nutrition.highlight: browns within the hour, so it is made last

name: Coleslaw
description: Shredded raw cabbage and carrot bound with mayonnaise.

histamine.note: Mayonnaise and vinegar in the dressing.

name: Potato salad
description: Boiled potato dressed while warm with mayonnaise or vinegar and herbs.

histamine.note: Mayonnaise and vinegar; and it is usually made hours ahead.

name: Waffles
description: Batter cooked in a hot iron so it crisps outside and stays soft within.

tcm.note: Baked batter with egg and butter.

histamine.note: Egg liberator; yeasted versions add more.

nutrition.highlight: the iron is the whole trick

name: Brownie
description: Dense underbaked chocolate cake, fudgy in the middle by design.

ayurveda.note: Cocoa is ushna and the fat makes it guru.

histamine.note: Cocoa is a fermented bean and both high and a liberator.

name: Cookies
description: Sweet baked discs — chocolate chip, unless specified otherwise.

histamine.note: Egg and chocolate carry it.

name: Muffin
description: A sweet cake baked in a paper case and called breakfast.

histamine.note: Egg-based.

name: Doughnut
description: Sweet yeasted dough fried and glazed.

histamine.note: Yeasted dough, fried and then held — several contributors.

name: Apple pie
description: Spiced apples under a pastry lid, served with cream or custard.

tcm.note: Apple is cool; the pastry and spice warm it.

ayurveda.note: Shita from the fruit; guru from the pastry.

histamine.note: The pastry and any cream, more than the apple.

name: Tiramisu
description: Coffee-soaked sponge layered with sweetened mascarpone and dusted with cocoa.

tcm.note: Coffee and cocoa over a rich dairy base.

ayurveda.note: Ushna from the coffee and cocoa.

histamine.note: Coffee, cocoa, raw egg and mascarpone — and it is deliberately left to sit overnight.

name: Rasmalai
description: Flattened chenna discs soaked in thickened saffron-cardamom milk.

tcm.note: Fresh cheese in reduced milk, served cold.

ayurveda.note: Chenna and milk are both shita; the saffron warms it slightly.

unani.note: Thanda-tar — unusually for mithai, a cooling sweet.

histamine.note: Low; fresh cheese and milk, though it does not keep.

name: Sandesh
description: Fresh chenna kneaded smooth with sugar and pressed into moulds — barely cooked.

tcm.note: Fresh cheese, lightly worked over low heat.

ayurveda.note: Chenna is shita and unfried — one of the lightest sweets there is.

histamine.note: Low; fresh cheese, made and eaten the same day.

name: Sushi
description: Vinegared rice with raw fish or vegetables — the rice is the part that takes years.

tcm.note: Cold vinegared rice with raw fish.

ayurveda.note: Matsya is ushna; the vinegar adds to it.

unani.note: Outside the classical record; served cold; the fish is garam, the rice thanda.

histamine.note: Raw fish plus vinegared rice held at room temperature — both matter, and freshness decides everything.

nutrition.highlight: the rice is the hard part

name: Sashimi
description: Raw fish sliced with nothing under it — no rice, no disguise.

ayurveda.note: Matsya is ushna, and raw food is classically harder to digest.

unani.note: Garam-tar; fish is warming in the Unani record.

histamine.note: Raw fish — the histamine load is entirely a function of the cold chain, not the recipe.

name: Chirashi
description: A bowl of sushi rice scattered with sashimi and pickles.

unani.note: Outside the classical record; read with sushi.

histamine.note: Raw fish on vinegared rice.

name: Gyudon
description: Thin beef and onion simmered in sweet soy and tipped over rice.

tcm.note: Simmered beef in soy over rice.

histamine.note: Soy-simmered beef with mirin.

nutrition.highlight: the fastest hot meal in Japan

name: Katsudon
description: A fried pork cutlet simmered briefly with egg and onion, slid over rice.

tcm.note: Fried pork with egg over rice.

histamine.note: Fried pork, egg and soy-mirin broth together.

name: Oyakodon
description: Chicken and egg simmered together over rice — parent and child, as the name says.

tcm.note: Chicken and egg in a soy broth.

ayurveda.note: Both anda and chicken are ushna.

histamine.note: Egg liberator plus a dashi-soy broth.

name: Tendon
description: Tempura laid over rice and brushed with a sweet soy reduction.

histamine.note: Prawns, egg batter and a long-kept tare.

nutrition.highlight: the tare soaks into the rice

name: Unadon
description: Grilled eel glazed with sweet soy over rice — a summer stamina dish.

tcm.note: Eel is warm and strongly tonifying in TCM; eaten in midsummer for stamina.

histamine.note: Pre-grilled eel and a decades-old tare in some shops — the reduction is deliberately never finished.

name: Ramen
description: Alkaline noodles in a broth simmered for hours, with toppings that vary by region.

histamine.note: Hours of bone broth plus soy or miso tare, plus cured pork on top — high on every layer.

name: Tsukemen
description: Cold thick noodles dipped into a concentrated hot broth, kept separate.

tcm.note: Cold noodles, very concentrated hot broth.

histamine.note: The broth is reduced harder than ramen's, which concentrates everything in it.

name: Yakisoba
description: Wheat noodles griddled with cabbage and pork in a sweet fruity brown sauce.

tcm.note: Griddled noodles in a thick sauce.

ayurveda.note: Ushna from the frying and sauce.

histamine.note: Yakisoba sauce is a fruit-and-vinegar reduction close to Worcestershire.

name: Okonomiyaki
description: A cabbage-heavy batter pancake griddled thick and covered in sauce, mayo and bonito.

tcm.note: Griddled batter with egg and cabbage.

ayurveda.note: Anda is ushna; the cabbage is shita beneath.

histamine.note: Egg, bonito flakes, mayonnaise and a Worcestershire-style sauce — four contributors on one pancake.

nutrition.highlight: cooked how you like it, as the name says

name: Takoyaki
description: Batter spheres with a piece of octopus inside, turned in a dimpled pan.

histamine.note: Octopus, egg batter, bonito and sauce.

name: Tempura
description: Ice-cold batter fried so briefly the coating stays pale and shatters.

tcm.note: Deep-fried; the batter is barely cooked.

histamine.note: Prawn and egg batter; the dipping sauce is dashi-based.

nutrition.highlight: pale, not golden — that is the skill

name: Tonkatsu
description: Pork loin in panko, deep-fried and sliced, with a thick fruity brown sauce.

histamine.note: Egg in the coating, and tonkatsu sauce is a fruit-and-vinegar reduction.

nutrition.highlight: sliced, so you can pick it up

name: Karaage
description: Chicken marinated in soy, sake and ginger, dusted in starch and fried twice.

histamine.note: Soy and sake marinade, usually overnight.

name: Yakitori
description: Chicken threaded on bamboo and grilled over charcoal, salted or glazed.

ayurveda.note: Ushna; grilling is the most heating method.

histamine.note: The tare glaze is a long-kept soy reduction; the salt version is much lower.

name: Teriyaki
description: Meat or fish glazed with soy, mirin and sugar reduced until it shines.

histamine.note: Soy and mirin reduction — the shine is the point and the problem.

name: Sukiyaki
description: Thin beef and vegetables simmered at the table in sweet soy, dipped in raw egg.

histamine.note: Soy, mirin and a raw egg dip.

nutrition.highlight: dipped in raw egg, at the table

name: Shabu-shabu
description: Paper-thin meat swished through plain kombu broth for seconds, then dipped.

tcm.note: Meat cooked seconds in a plain kelp broth — the lightest hotpot.

ayurveda.note: Ushna from the mamsa; the broth adds nothing.

histamine.note: The broth is only kombu, so this is far lower than a soy or miso hotpot — the dipping sauces decide it.

name: Oden
description: Fish cakes, egg, daikon and konnyaku simmered for hours in light dashi.

tcm.note: A long light simmer; daikon and konnyaku are cooling, the fish cakes warming.

ayurveda.note: Ushna from the fish and egg.

histamine.note: Processed fish cakes held hot for hours in dashi — the convenience-store pot has been simmering all day.

name: Miso soup
description: Dashi with miso whisked in off the heat, plus tofu and wakame.

tcm.note: Fermented soybean in a warm broth.

unani.note: Outside the classical record; garam by ferment.

histamine.note: Miso, dashi and wakame — three of the highest ingredients in the set, in the most ordinary bowl in Japan.

nutrition.highlight: the most ordinary bowl in Japan

name: Chawanmushi
description: Egg and dashi steamed into a barely-set savoury custard, eaten with a spoon.

tcm.note: Steamed egg in a light broth.

histamine.note: Egg liberator plus dashi.

name: Gyoza
description: Thin-skinned dumplings fried on one side and steamed on the other.

histamine.note: Soy in the filling and the dip both.

name: Onigiri
description: A triangle of salted rice around a filling, wrapped in nori.

tcm.note: Salted rice with a small filling.

histamine.note: Depends on the filling. Plain salt or umeboshi are the extremes — one is nearly nothing, the other is a fermented pickle.

name: Japanese curry rice
description: Thick sweet roux-based curry over rice — closer to a stew than anything South Asian.

ayurveda.note: Ushna from the spice and fat.

histamine.note: The roux blocks are heavily processed and the curry is famously better the next day.

nutrition.highlight: closer to stew than to curry

name: Omurice
description: Ketchup fried rice wrapped in a thin omelette, with more ketchup on top.

histamine.note: Egg plus a great deal of ketchup, which is concentrated tomato.

name: Korokke
description: Mashed potato and mince in panko, deep-fried into a flat oval.

histamine.note: Egg in the coating, and the brown sauce on top.

name: Nikujaga
description: Beef and potato simmered in dashi, soy and mirin until the potato collapses.

histamine.note: Dashi and soy, simmered long and usually eaten the next day.

name: Kinpira
description: Burdock and carrot cut into matchsticks and braised in soy, sesame and chilli.

tcm.note: Burdock is cooling, the chilli and sesame warming.

ayurveda.note: Ushna from the chilli and sesame oil.

histamine.note: Soy-braised.

name: Hijiki nimono
description: Rehydrated hijiki simmered with carrot, abura-age and soy.

ayurveda.note: Outside the classical record; read with the sea vegetables.

unani.note: Outside the classical record; placed with seaweed.

histamine.note: Dried seaweed plus soy.

name: Ohitashi
description: Greens blanched, squeezed and steeped in cold dashi with bonito on top.

unani.note: Outside the classical record; read with the leafy greens.

histamine.note: Spinach is usually the green, and it steeps in dashi — both rate high.

name: Sunomono
description: Cucumber and wakame dressed in sweetened rice vinegar, served very cold.

tcm.note: Raw cucumber and seaweed in vinegar, chilled.

histamine.note: Wakame and vinegar together.

name: Tamagoyaki
description: Layers of sweetened egg rolled in a rectangular pan into a striped block.

histamine.note: Egg liberator plus dashi in the batter.

name: Agedashi tofu
description: Tofu dusted in starch, fried, and sat in warm dashi broth.

tcm.note: Tofu is cool; frying warms it.

histamine.note: Dashi and soy broth over the tofu.

nutrition.highlight: crisp, until the broth gets it

name: Hiyayakko
description: A block of chilled silken tofu with ginger, spring onion and soy poured over.

tcm.note: Tofu is cool and moistening; served cold, in summer.

ayurveda.note: Shita — one of the coolest dishes in the set.

histamine.note: The tofu is nearly nothing; the soy and bonito on top are what rate it.

name: Ochazuke
description: Hot green tea or dashi poured over leftover rice with a salty topping.

tcm.note: Green tea over rice — light and cooling.

unani.note: Outside the classical record; read with rice and green tea.

histamine.note: Depends on the topping; the plain tea-and-rice base is very low.

name: Zosui
description: Rice simmered in the leftover hotpot broth until it thickens — the end of the meal.

histamine.note: Made from broth that has been simmering all evening.

name: Natto gohan
description: Fermented soybeans stirred with soy and mustard over hot rice.

unani.note: Outside the classical record; garam by ferment.

histamine.note: Natto and soy together — one of the highest-histamine breakfasts there is.

name: Saba shioyaki
description: Mackerel salted, rested and grilled until the skin blisters.

histamine.note: Mackerel is a scombroid — the classic histamine-poisoning fish, and salting it before grilling adds time.

name: Buta no kakuni
description: Pork belly simmered for hours in soy, sake and sugar until a chopstick goes through.

histamine.note: Hours of soy and sake braising — and the sake is a DAO blocker.

name: Daifuku
description: Soft pounded mochi wrapped around sweet red bean paste.

tcm.note: Glutinous rice, which is warm and binding.

histamine.note: Very low — rice and bean paste, nothing fermented or aged.

name: Dorayaki
description: Two small honey pancakes sandwiching red bean paste.

ayurveda.note: Anda and madhu are both ushna.

histamine.note: Egg in the batter.

name: Taiyaki
description: Fish-shaped waffle batter filled with red bean, custard or chocolate.

ayurveda.note: Ushna from the egg and sugar.

histamine.note: Egg batter; the custard filling adds more.

name: Dango
description: Rice-flour balls on a skewer, grilled and glazed with sweet soy.

tcm.note: Grilled glutinous rice with a soy glaze.

histamine.note: The mitarashi glaze is soy-based.

name: Anmitsu
description: Cubes of agar jelly with red bean, fruit and black sugar syrup.

histamine.note: Low.

name: Castella
description: A dense honey sponge cake with no butter — Portuguese by origin, Nagasaki by adoption.

histamine.note: Egg-heavy.

name: Melonpan
description: A sweet bun under a crackled cookie crust — no melon involved.

tcm.note: Yeasted bread with a baked sugar crust.

histamine.note: Yeasted dough and egg.

nutrition.highlight: no melon in it at all

name: Purin
description: Steamed egg custard under a bitter caramel — firmer than crème caramel.

ayurveda.note: Anda is ushna over a shita milk base.

histamine.note: Egg liberator.

name: Warabimochi

description: The coconut-rich laksa — thick, orange and heavy with prawn.

histamine.note: Shrimp paste, prawns and cockles.

unani.note: Tamarind is thanda in the Unani reading.

description: Flat rice noodles fried over ferocious heat with cockles, egg and dark soy.

description: Noodles in a prawn-and-pork stock so dark it looks like coffee.

description: Dough slapped and stretched paper-thin, folded and griddled into flaky layers.

name: Roti jala
description: Batter drizzled in a lattice onto a griddle, folded and eaten with curry.

ayurveda.note: Ushna from the egg and turmeric.

histamine.note: Egg batter.

name: Murtabak
description: Roti dough wrapped around spiced minced meat and egg, then griddled flat.

histamine.note: Minced meat, egg and a long-rested dough.

nutrition.highlight: the dough is the same as roti canai

name: Nasi kandar
description: Rice under a deliberate flood of several different curry gravies at once.

histamine.note: Multiple long-cooked gravies, held warm all day.

description: Pork ribs simmered for hours with garlic and either white pepper or herbs.

tcm.note: Long bone broth with warming herbs — a classic tonic soup.

histamine.note: Hours of pork bone broth.

description: Poached chicken with rice cooked in its stock, and three sauces beside it.

histamine.note: Chicken stock in the rice; the chilli and ginger sauces add more.

description: Whole crab in a thick sweet-savoury tomato-chilli gravy, mopped up with buns.

description: Charcoal-toasted bread with coconut-egg jam and a slab of cold butter.

description: Chicken simmered in spice water first, then fried — so the flavour goes through.

description: A pale mild coconut curry with candlenut and lemongrass, eaten at Eid.

description: Mixed vegetables in a thin spiced coconut broth.

histamine.note: Terasi in the paste.

description: Young jackfruit stewed for hours in coconut milk and palm sugar until it turns brown.

description: Fish and sago cakes fried and served in a dark sour-sweet vinegar sauce.

description: A thick spongy pancake split and filled with chocolate, peanuts and condensed milk.

description: Green rice-flour balls with molten palm sugar inside, rolled in coconut.

description: Fried glutinous rice balls coated in sesame with mung bean paste inside.

histamine.note: Low.

description: Steamed rice-flour cake built in coloured layers, each set before the next.

description: Green pandan crepes rolled around coconut cooked in palm sugar.

description: Rice porridge with shredded chicken, crackers, soy and fried shallots.

description: Rice boiled inside a banana-leaf tube until dense enough to slice.

description: Rice cooked inside a woven palm-leaf pouch — the Eid rice.

histamine.note: Very low.

description: Tempeh sliced, marinated in coriander water and fried crisp.

description: Blanched vegetables tossed with spiced grated coconut.

description: Blanched vegetables under a spiced peanut sauce thinned with tamarind water.

description: Clear oxtail soup with potato and carrot, spiced with nutmeg and clove.

description: Whole fish rubbed with spice paste, wrapped in banana leaf and grilled.

description: Spiced fish paste wrapped in banana leaf and grilled until it firms.

histamine.note: Processed fish paste plus a chilli-terasi base.

description: Fried tofu cubes under sweet peanut sauce and fried shallots.

histamine.note: Peanut sauce and kecap manis.

description: Starch and prawn crackers that puff violently when they hit hot oil.

histamine.note: Dried prawn in the dough.

description: Bitter crackers pounded from melinjo nuts and fried.

description: Grated coconut toasted dry with spices until brown and crumbly.

histamine.note: Low.

description: Raw shallot, lemongrass and chilli tossed with hot coconut oil — never cooked.

description: Chilli pounded with grilled shrimp paste, tomato and lime — the everyday table sambal.

name: Acar
description: Vegetables pickled in turmeric vinegar with peanuts and sesame.

description: Tortillas dipped in chilli sauce, rolled around a filling and baked under cheese.

description: Hominy and pork simmered for hours in a chilli broth, dressed with raw cabbage and lime.

description: A sauce of dried chillies, nuts, seeds, spices and chocolate — thirty ingredients is not unusual.

description: Roasted poblanos stuffed with cheese, dipped in egg foam and fried.

description: Elote taken off the cob and served in a cup with its dressing.

description: Goat or beef stewed for hours in a dried-chilli adobo, served with its consommé.

description: Pork marinated in achiote and sour orange, wrapped in banana leaf and pit-roasted.

description: Raw fish 'cooked' in lime juice with onion and chilli — minutes, not hours.

description: Raw prawns drowned in blended lime, chilli and coriander — fiercer and wetter than ceviche.

description: Pastry folded around a filling and crimped — every country claims its own version.

description: Fish stewed in coconut milk, dendê and peppers in a clay pot.

description: Salted beef grilled over wood on long skewers and carved at the table.

description: Beef pounded thin, breaded and fried — a schnitzel by another name.

description: A thick hominy and squash stew with cured meat — winter food of the Andes.

description: Fresh corn ground with basil and cheese, steamed in its own husk.

description: Marinated beef heart grilled on skewers — Lima street food.

description: Beef stir-fried with onion, tomato and soy, served with chips and rice both.

description: Shredded chicken in a thick sauce of ají amarillo, bread and walnuts.

description: Chilled mashed yellow potato pressed in layers with lime, chilli and a filling.

description: A big stew of meat and every root vegetable available, thickened by the starch itself.

description: Beef simmered until it falls into threads, in a tomato and pepper sofrito.

description: Green plantain fried, smashed flat and fried again.

description: Condensed milk and cocoa cooked down and rolled in sprinkles.

description: Flaky pastry cups of egg custard blistered black on top.

description: The golden crust at the bottom of the rice pot — the part people compete over.

description: Rice pudding set with saffron and rose water, decorated with cinnamon.

description: Nougat of pistachio and rose set with the sap of a desert shrub.

description: Saffron and pistachio brittle cooked in butter until it snaps.
